question: How can the same mantras bind one person and liberate another?
premises: The mantras bind that person firmly in the great prison-house of becoming.
The mantras also possess a grace-bestowing power.
That grace-bestowing power is kindled by the guru.
inference: Mantras bind by their Vama aspect but liberate through their grace-bestowing power when awakened by the guru.
plain_english: The mantras bind him firmly in the great prison-house of worldly existence. But their grace-bestowing power, when kindled by the guru, is different.
